dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Traveler from another world, you have the Prinzessin's permission to enjoy a brief moment of peace.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: But be ready, for once I have peered into this dark dominion and beheld the treachery within, I shall rain down Thundering Retribution upon this place...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: And when the curtain of doom falls, thou shalt give it thy full, undivided attention!
